scope: Implement the approved Reports Intelligence design with PostgreSQL-backed management KPIs, lifecycle and ownership analysis, profile-driven data-quality gaps, monthly and dimensional drilldowns, exact asset results, and server CSV export without changing the production architecture or database schema.

evidence: frontend/src/pages/ReportsPage.tsx renders only normalized server-owned report data
frontend/src/pages/ReportsPage.test.tsx verifies live queues, monthly drilldown, field-gap drilldown, and export hooks
backend/src/reports.ts derives all counts, dimensions, trends, quality issues, and rows from PostgreSQL
No browser-owned report totals or synthetic report records are included
backend/src/reports.ts executes report calculations server-side and applies appendRegistryFilters for profile fields
backend/test/reporting-contract.test.ts verifies registry-driven report and export behavior
KPI, row, dimension, trend, quality, and CSV queries share reportWhere and applyReportScope
backend/test/reporting-contract.test.ts verifies the shared scoped filter expression
Reports expose category, lifecycle status, location, owner, vendor, model, and project breakdowns
Each breakdown value applies its corresponding server-side query parameter
Leadership and Operations views expose rework, e-waste, metadata-gap, aging, and date-received information
Profile-required field gaps are calculated from active profile definitions and storage mappings
Every KPI, management queue, breakdown, quality issue, and monthly trend invokes a matching report filter
Every returned asset row opens its actual asset workspace route
frontend/src/api.ts normalizes KPI, dimension, trend, quality, row, and pagination structures
frontend/src/api.test.ts and frontend/src/pages/ReportsPage.test.tsx verify defensive rendering contracts
Export current view uses the same report ID and query scope as the visible result
backend/src/reports.ts generates the CSV server-side under report.export and records REPORT_EXPORTED activity
Charts display numeric values and month labels in addition to visual length and color
Breakdowns and quality indicators include text labels and exact counts
Reports uses the approved AppShell, PageHeader, shared controls, surfaces, tokens, and breakpoints
No page-specific shell, overlay implementation, additional stylesheet, or hosting change was introduced
The change is delivered as a component-aware delta from 1.3.10 to 1.3.11
No full installer, database migration, upload change, or PostgreSQL replacement is included
The delta embeds this Framework v1.0 conformance record and DCR-2026-001 remains approved by Gaurav Mehta
The permanent updater will record package hash, operator, components, checks, and outcome in the release ledger
